name: Brood vent icon
description: UI slot icon for Broodling: its sample, `ss.sample.drone`, on the weapon's tile. The weapon icons used to compose each weapon's projectile; since the level-up became a choice of which sample fills a syringe, a weapon is the sample it was taken as, so the slot shows that and the tray, the codex and the level-up card all agree on what the thing is. Composed through `use`, so redrawing the sample redraws the slot. The tile keeps its colour, which is what the `distinct` rule holds apart, and goes gold when the weapon awakens.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin: the same sample on a gold tile.
